title: cladium junceum var. pauciflorum
intro: Cladium junceum var. pauciflorum, commonly known as Small-flowered Sawgrass, is a type of aquatic plant belonging to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Small-flowered Sawgrass include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic actions, which may help in alleviating symptoms of various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
